name: photonic
description: AI-native vector/video editor MCP — local document tools, optional live GUI attach.
long_description: Runs on your machine (files, GPU, ffmpeg). No sandbox: tools execute with your user privileges. Default tools/list is compact; pass full:true for the complete catalog. Attach to a running GUI via mcp-proxy when possible.

mode.title: Session mode
mode.description: headless = --mcp-stdio document in this process. attach = use mcp-proxy against a running GUI (set PHOTONIC_MCP_TOKEN).
